requirements.Title: AI Productivity, Scan Workflow & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Implement advanced AI-driven productivity features, including scan workflow automation and enhanced manageability tools, to simplify business operations for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB need for efficiency and minimal IT intervention, providing a competitive edge and aligning with the product's value proposition.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with SMB portal and device management solutions
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI productivity features are available in the product; scan workflow automation is functional; manageability tools are accessible via the SMB portal.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO (Total Cost of Ownership)
requirements.Description: Design the printer to deliver the lowest business TCO in its class, including efficient ink usage, minimal maintenance, and optimized consumable costs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs are highly cost-sensitive; lowest TCO is a key differentiator and driver for purchase.
requirements.Dependencies: Sustainability features, maintenance design, consumables pricing
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent cost analysis confirms lowest TCO compared to direct competitors in the SMB tank printer segment.

requirements.Title: 80k or 2-Year Warranty (Whichever First)
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty of 80,000 pages printed or 2 years, whichever comes first, for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Warranty is a key purchase consideration for SMBs, ensuring reliability and reducing perceived risk.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are clearly stated in product documentation and reflected in warranty registration systems.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Customer Replaceable Parts (PHA) and MINK at Service Centre
requirements.Description: Enable customer replaceable parts (PHA) and MINK replacement at service centers, with a target for more parts to be customer replaceable if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and cost for SMBs without dedicated IT, improving user experience and satisfaction.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, DVAR
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: At least PHA is customer replaceable and MINK is serviceable at authorized centers; documentation and training are available.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Utilize keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure only genuine HP supplies are used.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents user errors and protects HP supplies revenue.
requirements.Stakeholders: Supplies Quality, Tech Reg, Prod Steward
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer only accepts correctly keyed bottles; nozzles and bottles are physically incompatible with non-genuine supplies.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU: SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB Portal Support
requirements.Description: Ensure the non-PDL SKU supports SMB2.0 Solutions and is fully integrated with the Advanced View SMB portal.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses the need for centralized device management for unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU is compatible with SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View portal out-of-the-box.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Printing as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: Support Printing as a Service (PaaS) model for both PDL and non-PDL SKUs.
requirements.Rationale: Enables flexible business models and recurring revenue streams for HP and partners.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features are available for both SKUs; billing and management workflows tested.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU: Improved Print Speed and PDL/PS Support
requirements.Description: PDL SKU must achieve print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improvement from current 25/19) and support Page Description Languages (PDL) and PostScript (PS).
requirements.Rationale: Meets the needs of more demanding SMB customers and competitive benchmarks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves specified speeds and passes PDL/PS compatibility tests.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the PDL SKU meets Blue Angel environmental certification requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator and compliance requirement in key markets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU receives Blue Angel certification prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Incorporate a replaceable maintenance box to support new use cases and reduce downtime.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new SMB use cases and enhances serviceability for non-IT users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is user-replaceable and instructions are provided; tested for usability by non-IT users.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan AI Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan' solutions to enhance print and scan quality automatically.
requirements.Rationale: Delivers superior output quality with minimal user intervention, a key differentiator for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features demonstrably improve print/scan quality in benchmark tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Printer Management
requirements.Description: Provide a consolidated portal for SMB customers to manage multiple printers, including device status, usage, and maintenance alerts.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses need for easy, centralized management for offices without dedicated IT staff.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal software development, device firmware integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is available and functional; users can manage at least 6-15 printers as per target customer profile.

requirements.Title: Sustainability: 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure that at least 60% of the printer's plastic is made from recycled content, surpassing key competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key purchase driver and competitive differentiator in the SMB segment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product composition verified to have 60% RCP; documented in product specs and marketing.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing functionality through the HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile printing is a top use case and expectation for modern SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing is tested and functional with HP App on major platforms (iOS, Android).

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to collect anonymized usage, performance, and error data for product improvement and support.
requirements.Rationale: Supports proactive support, quality monitoring, and future product enhancements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is collected, transmitted securely, and accessible for analysis; compliance with privacy regulations.
